notes: Null encoder selects the latest completed eight-epoch MAIN encoder of the correct corpus and pretraining seed, never a partial pilot or a best-test model.
One encoder is reused across ten downstream seeds. This is not ten independent pretraining runs.
Wiki-CS uses all twenty official splits; ten seeds per split produce two hundred probes.
Full budgets and declared reconstruction assumptions remain in the existing stage configurations.

Pretraining resume paths must be set explicitly. Batch stages skip only verified successful child runs in their own matching ledger; an unfinished child restarts unless resumed using the existing head CLI.
